decisions: Preserve conic Eccentricity and Rho raw binary64 values; current scalar exchanges do not define finite domains, clamps, defaults or geometric formulas.
Finite-conic Rho construction arguments and optional curve installation/copy are current native checkpoints, not archive identity, successful geometry or rollback guarantees.
Cone Sine/Cosine getters and canonical producers copy raw values; do not impose normalization or a trigonometric pair identity.
Keep current cone axis/origin/radius/sine/cosine request positions distinct; repeated getters are not a coherent saved-object snapshot.
Cylinder and sphere typed point/vector assignments do not prove bit-copy, normalization, units or frame; direct radius stores retain all 64 bits.
Cone owner member0xF8 and element stride0x108 are distinct runtime facts. Conditional array copy and callback-sensitive Count-1 are not stable entity IDs or final insertion guarantees.
Parabola trim comparisons admit ordered A<B or unordered on the first branch, with E8 consulted only otherwise; this is not a universal stored E8<1 constraint.
Parabola unbounded-conic E8 is the fourth formal argument, after two point references and a unit-vector reference; the fifth double comes from a separate provider.
Preserve failed-proof and diagnostic provenance qualifications. No native capture or frozen proof was rerun.
